none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives may be nonconvex; a global minimizer exists. The gradient is globally L-Lipschitz.

problem_class.label: pl
problem_class.details: Globally, 2μ(f(x)−f*) ≤ ‖∇f(x)‖², with 0 < μ ≤ L and f(x0)−f* ≤ Δ.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed, with E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Only gradient samples are supplied; no function values or Hessian oracle are available. All Params, including L, μ, ρ, σ, p, Δ, ε and x0, are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedPLHessian.lean: spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central moment bound E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖^p ≤ σ^p, where 1 < p ≤ 2 and σ ≥ 0. Finite variance is not required when p < 2.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: An arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension bound is specified.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable and its derivative satisfies ‖D∇f(x)−D∇f(y)‖op ≤ ρ‖x−y‖ globally, with ρ ≥ 0. This is Lipschitz continuity of the objective Hessian, with no samplewise smoothness requirement.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output X with integrable objective gap and E[f(X)−f*] ≤ ε, where ε > 0. No particular iterate or averaging rule is required.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over algorithm randomness and the IID oracle seeds. The supplied budget caps the total number of individual gradient calls deterministically, including batching and initialization.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines nonconvex global PL geometry, a globally Lipschitz Hessian, and an unbiased gradient oracle with only a bounded p-th central moment, allowing infinite variance. This is a specialized variant of standard smooth stochastic PL optimization.
